Job Title : Full Stack Developer

Company : Global Surf IT Pvt Ltd.

Location : Infopark, Kochi

Experience : 4 years

Job Summary

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer (Next.js + NestJS) for our business domains, who will be responsible for building a secure, cloud-based internal business platform that will grow over time to support multiple areas of the organization, starting with core HR functions and expanding into other business modules. We're looking for a Full Stack Developer to help design and build this platform from the ground up, with strong ownership across both frontend and backend. This is a foundational role: early decisions around architecture, data design, and security will shape the platform as it grows.

Job Responsibilities

Build and maintain a modern web frontend that consumes backend APIs.

Design and build a backend service layer using a modular, well-structured architecture that can scale as new features are added.

Design and evolve a relational database schema that supports secure, isolated access to data.

Implement authentication and authorization, including role-based access control and multi-factor authentication.

Build out shared core services used across the platform: user management, notifications, audit logging, file storage, and search.

Apply security best practices throughout: input validation, rate limiting, encryption of sensitive data, and secure API design.

Work within a structured codebase alongside deployment and monitoring practices suited for a cloud environment.

Collaborate on sprint planning and help turn a phased roadmap into shippable increments.

Requirements And Qualifications

Strong experience with modern frontend frameworks and Node.js-based backend frameworks.

Proficiency in TypeScript with experience working in strict, type-safe codebases.

Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar) and modern ORMs.

Strong understanding of REST API design, request validation, secure-by-default backend development, role-based access control (RBAC), secure data isolation, and token-based authentication/authorization flows.
